webster.text: A detail with reasons; a series of reasons assigned; as Dr. Sparrow's rationale of the Common Prayer.

example.quote: He sees the rationale of the whole system, its origin and its operation; and as it is best supported when best understood, the human faculties act with boldness, and acquire, under this form of government, a gigantic manliness.
example.cite: Thomas Paine, Rights of Man, Parts One and Two (London, 1791-92)
